title: Here’s How Freaky the Universe Would Look If Light Slowed to 3 Miles Per Hour - Nautilus
gist: Developer Dmitry Brant's web simulator Relativity Park sets the speed of light to 3.11 mph so the effects of Einstein's special relativity become visible at walking pace.

insights.claim: Light travels at nearly 671 million miles per hour, a fact most people rarely consider day to day.
insights.speaker: David Nield
insights.locator: Day to day, most of us

insights.claim: Relativity Park, a web project by developer Dmitry Brant, sets the speed of light to 3.11 miles per hour, a brisk walking pace, to make the effects of Einstein's 1905 special relativity obvious.
insights.speaker: David Nield
insights.so_what: Example of interactive simulation as a science-education tool.
insights.locator: A new web project called Relativity Park
